review_candidates.title: Consultant-CHE/HPD, Climate Change, Health-System Resilience. Band level B.
review_candidates.description: Contractual Arrangement External consultant Contract Duration (Years, Months, Days) 6 months Job Posting Sep 24, 2026, 12:08:24 PM Closing Date Oct 2, 2026, 12:59:00 AM Primary Location Egypt-Cairo Organization EM/HPD Health Promotion, Disease Prevention & Control Schedule Full-time IMPORTANT NOTICE: Please note that the deadline for receipt of applications indicated above reflects your personal device's system settings. Purpose of the consultancy To provide dedicated technical expertise for climate change and health across the CHE portfolio, covering health vulnerability and adaptation assessments (H-VAA), health national adaptation planning (H-NAP), health-system resilience and air quality, and provide guidance in the management and coordination of the CHE workplan under the Wellcome award. Background The CHE unit is implementing an equity-led climate and health programme (2026 to 2029) covering a critical-three portfolio (Somalia, Yemen, Afghanistan) receiving full assessment packages, and a doable-five portfolio adding Sudan (national-led) and Egypt (on uptake). Deliverables include five H-VAAs, five policy briefs, adaptation planning support and regional public goods. The consultant is one of two regional consultants forming the technical core of the unit. National consultants embedded in each priority country deliver in-country, supported by remote-sensing inputs where access is constrained. Work to be performed Output 1: Health vulnerability and adaptation assessments delivered for the critical-three countries Deliverable 1.1: Adapted H-VAA methodology, tools and remote-sensing protocol for fragile and access-constrained settings, by December 2026. Deliverable 1.2: Technical review and quality assurance of the national H-VAA data collection and analysis for Somalia, Yemen, Afghanistan and Sudan, including methodological guidance to the country teams, throughout the assignment. Deliverable 1.3: Draft H-VAA reports for the critical-three countries taken to technical review stage, and technical review of the Sudan national-led draft, by March 2027. Final reports fall under any follow-on contract. Output 2: Health-system resilience and adaptation planning advanced Deliverable 2.1: Health-system resilience components integrated into each assessment package, and H-NAP roadmap outlines agreed with Ministries of Health, by March 2027. Deliverable 2.2: Policy brief template and first drafts for the critical-three countries, by March 2027. Output 3: Air quality workstream delivered Deliverable 3.1: Ambient and household air quality assessment scoping and protocols for Egypt and Afghanistan, and regional air-quality-and-health technical inputs, by February 2027. Deliverable 3.2: Monthly progress reports against the agreed workplan, from October 2026 to March 2027 inclusive. Education Required Qualifications Essential: Minimum first university degree for lower end of range, an advanced university degree for mid and high end of range, in public health, environmental health, environmental science, climate science or a related field. Experience Essential: At least five years of relevant experience in climate change and health, health-system resilience or environmental health, including experience conducting or supervising vulnerability and adaptation assessments. Desirable: Experience in fragile, conflict-affected or access-constrained settings; experience with the WHO H-VAA and H-NAP guidance; prior work with WHO or the UN system; experience with air quality and health assessment methods; project coordination experience. Skills/ Technical Knowledge Demonstrated knowledge of climate-and-health assessment methods, including use of remote-sensing and secondary data. Strong analytical writing; ability to coordinate multi-country teams; sound judgement in politically sensitive environments. WHO competencies: teamwork; respecting and promoting individual and cultural differences; communication; producing results; moving forward in a changing environment. Language Essential: Expert knowledge of English (read, write, speak). Desirable: Working knowledge of Arabic. Location: Medical Clearance WHO Regional Office for the Eastern Mediterranean, Cairo, Egypt The selected Consultant will be expected to provide a medical certificate of fitness for work. Travel The selected consultant is expected to travel on country missions according to a travel itinerary that will be subject to confirmation. (If travel is involved, a medical certificate of fitness for work will be required.) All travel arrangements will be made by WHO – WHO will not be responsible for tickets purchased by the Consultant without the express, prior authorization of WHO. While on mission under the terms of this consultancy, the Consultant will receive subsistence allowance . Visas requirements: it is the consultant’s responsibility to fulfil visa requirements and ask for visa support letter(s) if needed. Additional Information Section This vacancy notice may be used to identify candidates for other similar consultancies at the same level. Only candidates under serious consideration will be contacted. Remuneration is in line with WHO consultant established rates Successful candidates will be included in the roster for consideration for future contractual engagement via a consultancy, as they become available. Inclusion in the roster does not guarantee any future contractual relationship with WHO A written test may be used as a form of screening. If your candidature is retained for interview, you will be required to provide, in advance, a scanned copy of the degree(s)/diploma(s)/certificate(s) required for this position. The list can be accessed through the link: http://www.whed.net/. Some professional certificates may not appear in the WHED and will require individual review. review_candidates.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Cloud Platform
review_candidates.description: Who We Are Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale. Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term. About the role: As a Senior Engineer in the Infrastructure org, you will help evolve the cloud foundations behind every Samsara product. Your goal will be to reduce systemic production risk and enable continued growth by making infrastructure safer to change, easier to operate, and more resilient and cost-efficient at scale. You will bring deep expertise in at least one infrastructure domain, such as compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud control planes, and apply it across our multi-account, multi-region AWS environment. You will lead work such as modernizing compute and stateful infrastructure, strengthening capacity and failure isolation, and building standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation. You will partner with product engineering teams to turn recurring risks and manual operations into durable platforms and paved paths. We do not expect you to be an expert in every infrastructure domain. We are looking for engineers who have built and operated critical systems at significant scale, understand how infrastructure fails, and can use that experience to improve both our platforms and our engineering practices. You should apply if: You want to impact the industries that run our world: The software, firmware, and hardware you build will result in real-world impact, helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely. You are a life-long learner: We have ambitious goals. Every Samsarian has a growth mindset as we work with a wide range of technologies, challenges, and customers that push us to learn on the go. You believe customers are more than a number: Samsara engineers enjoy a rare closeness to the end user and you will have the opportunity to participate in customer interviews, collaborate with customer success and product managers, and use metrics to ensure our work is translating into better customer outcomes. You are a team player: Working on our Samsara Engineering teams requires a mix of independent effort and collaboration. Motivated by our mission, we’re all racing toward our connected operations vision, and we intend to win together. In this role, you will: Design, build, and operate reliable cloud platforms, bringing depth in one or more areas such as compute, networking, storage, stateful systems, or infrastructure control planes. Improve the scalability, capacity management, isolation, recovery, and cost efficiency of critical production infrastructure. Build standardized infrastructure-as-code workflows and reusable automation that support self-service provisioning, testing, progressive rollout, reconciliation, rollback, and drift prevention. Identify shared failure modes and build safeguards that prevent localized failures from escalating into broad customer impact. Contribute to multi-account, multi-region, and isolated AWS architectures, including regulated environments such as GovCloud. Participate in operational ownership and incident response, using incidents and near misses to drive durable architectural improvements. Mentor engineers, raise the quality of infrastructure design and operational judgment, and establish patterns that can be adopted across the organization. Clearly communicate architecture, trade-offs, risks, and migration plans to technical and organizational stakeholders. Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices. Minimum Requirements For This Role. 6+ years of experience designing and building software, infrastructure, or distributed systems, including operating critical systems in production. Deep expertise in at least one of the following: compute and workload orchestration, networking, storage and stateful systems, or cloud infrastructure control planes. Strong software-engineering fundamentals in Go, Python, Java, or a similar language. Hands-on experience designing and operating infrastructure on a major public cloud platform; AWS experience is preferred. Experience using infrastructure as code, such as Terraform, to safely manage production infrastructure. Strong understanding of capacity management, failure domains, observability, rollout safety, and production recovery. Demonstrated ability to lead complex technical initiatives across teams and through ambiguous problem spaces. Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience An ideal candidate also has: Designing and operating large-scale compute or container platforms such as ECS, EKS, Kubernetes, or similar orchestration systems. Designing and operating stateful distributed systems such as Kafka, OpenSearch, managed databases, caching, or large-scale storage platforms. Building internal infrastructure platforms, control planes, or self-service developer experiences adopted across multiple teams. Designing multi-account or multi-region cloud architectures with strong workload isolation and disaster recovery. Leading major infrastructure migrations while maintaining availability and controlling operational risk. Delivering measurable improvements in infrastructure capacity, cost efficiency, or developer self-service. Total Rewards At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time. Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here. Flexible Working At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable. Belonging at Samsara At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact. Accommodations Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process. Our Commitment to Authenticity We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information. Fraudulent Employment Offers Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

review_candidates.description: Technical Sales Engineer in Coatings and Construction Job Reference: JB869 – Cairo, Egypt REDA Chemicals About the Company At REDA Chemicals, we passionately market and distribute a unique and innovative portfolio of specialty raw materials and industrial chemicals. We have one of the largest distribution networks with local services in more than 34 countries across the Middle East, Asia, and Africa. We are currently looking for go-getters to join our team for the following role: Title: Technical Sales Engineer Industry: C1 – Coatings and Construction Job Function: Sales Employment Type: Full-time Location: Cairo, Egypt About the Role As a Technical Sales Engineer in the Coatings & Construction business at REDA Chemicals Egypt, you will play a pivotal role in driving growth and strengthening our market position within the coatings, paints, and construction chemicals segment. This role combines technical understanding with strong commercial skills, requiring familiarity with formulation chemistry and applications in coatings and construction, such as decorative and industrial paints, protective coatings, waterproofing systems, flooring solutions, mortars, and admixtures. You will be responsible for managing and expanding customer accounts, identifying new business opportunities, and positioning REDA Chemicals as a trusted technical and commercial partner to manufacturers, applicators, and contractors across Egypt, you will deliver value-added, solution-driven offerings that address customer challenges and support sustainable, profitable growth. This position is ideal for technically inclined sales professionals with a strong background in specialty chemicals and a passion for developing long-term customer partnerships in the Coatings & Construction market. Responsibilities Develop and maintain long-term relationships with customers in the Coatings & Construction industry (e.g., paint manufacturers, construction chemicals producers, contractors, and applicators). Identify new business opportunities and convert qualified leads into profitable sales. Monitor market trends, competitors, and customer needs to identify areas for business expansion in Egypt. Promote and sell specialty raw materials such as resins, binders, pigments, fillers, additives, polymers, admixtures, and related solutions for coatings and construction applications. Collaborate with business unit management, supply chain, to deliver tailored solutions that meet customer requirements. Achieve sales targets, margin objectives, and growth KPIs, in line with the company’s strategic objectives. Provide regular sales forecasts, pipeline updates, and performance reports to management. Represent REDA Chemicals at customer meetings, technical visits, trade shows, and industry events as required. Requirements Bachelor’s degree in chemistry, Chemical Engineering, or a closely related field. Minimum 4 years of experience in sales specialty chemicals industry Previous working experience with a chemical distribution company or chemical manufacturer is an advantage. Familiarity with market trends and basic regulatory considerations in the coatings and construction chemicals sector. Demonstrated ability to develop and manage long-term customer relationships with key manufacturers, formulators, applicators, and technical/R&D teams. Familiarity with CRM systems and very good command of MS Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, etc.). Very good communication skills in Arabic and English, both written and verbal. Strong selling, negotiation, presentation, and time-management skills. Ability and willingness to travel across Egypt, work both indoors and outdoors, and visit customer and manufacturing sites. Candidates should be based in Greater Cairo.
